create_beit_model: create a BEiT base model with embeddings, encoder, and pooling for image feature extraction
build_beit_image_classifier: build a BEiT model with an image classification head for ImageNet-style classification
run_beit_masked_image_modeling: run BEiT masked image modeling to predict visual tokens from masked patches
build_beit_semantic_segmentation: build a BEiT model with UPerNet head for pixel-level semantic segmentation
create_beit_backbone: create a BEiT backbone with optional FPN feature pyramid for DETR and MaskFormer
